Container.Name: Discovarr
Container.Overview: Discover movies and TV shows and request them: approved requests are handed to Radarr and Sonarr, and their status is reconciled back automatically.
Container.Description:
Discovarr is a self-hosted media request and discovery manager. Users browse a catalog or title pages, request a film or individual seasons, and watch those requests move from pending to downloading to available. Requests are added to Radarr or Sonarr by Discovarr itself, so nothing has to be copied between tabs.
Highlights:
- Requests go straight to Radarr/Sonarr, with per-season control for series - Library awareness: films and series you already own are labelled instead of being requested again - Reconciliation on a schedule, plus collection browsing and a watchlist - Local accounts with roles (administrator, user) and a simple approval queue - Six bundled themes, no client bundle, no external assets
No database server and no API keys beyond Radarr/Sonarr are needed: the app stores everything in SQLite inside the appdata folder, and metadata comes from TMDB.

Container.Requires: A Radarr and/or Sonarr instance with its URL and API key, reachable from this container.
Container.Changes: 1.0.3: signing in works again behind a reverse proxy, including from a browser holding an expired session; on phones and tablets the browse menu and the filters open as sheets over the grid, with buttons that stay on screen while you scroll; the theme is saved to the account and follows you to your other devices.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Discovarr web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds discovarr.db (users, requests, settings) and must persist across updates.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: Administrator email
Config.Description: Optional. Creates the first administrator without the browser setup page.

Config.Name: Administrator password
Config.Description: Optional. Password for the administrator above; leave both blank and create the account at /setup instead.
